_comment: Programs that are NOT apt packages. Pinned here, installed by scripts/35-programs.sh at every boot (idempotent, version-checked). DATA of these programs lives in manifest/services.json data_paths, so it is encrypted and restored by the memory repo.

programs.name: x-ui
programs.description: 3x-ui panel + xray core (single Go binary; DB lives in /etc/x-ui and is persisted)

programs.name: mirzabot-src
programs.description: Mirza Bot sources (upstream installer drives PHP/Apache/MySQL itself); kept so the exact revision is reproducible
